goal: Record Claude mega-session cache and code-throughput milestone
body: Telemetry milestone from Dave's live Claude session: $175.95 total API-equivalent cost, 3h07m47s API time over 1d04h06m wall time, 8,476 lines added and 97 removed. Fable 5.1 dominated with 203.5M cache-read tokens, 4.0M cache-write, 835k output and $170.67; Opus 5 contributed 3.4M cache-read and $5.28. Main prompt cache: 418 requests, 98% of input tokens served from cache, only 7 misses, one expected rebuild. Session meter showed 7% used and weekly 33% used. Treat as evidence of sustained long-session orchestration with extremely high cache reuse rather than raw fresh-input spend.
